edge_fields.n: edge number printed on the map as '#n'
edge_fields.from/to: canonical node names (see nodes[].name); from_as_filed/to_as_filed keep the names used in the register row
edge_fields.date: date or range of the tie as filed
edge_fields.grade: V verified | I partly supported | null for context ties
edge_fields.sequence_only: true = two documented facts in time order, no causal link claimed
edge_fields.status: active | ended | changed | pending | enjoined | retired (retired edges are kept, never deleted)
edge_fields.status_date/status_note: when and why the status was set
edge_fields.added_in: date (version) the edge entered the map
edge_fields.last_checked: latest date the edge or its node roles were re-verified
edge_fields.check_note/check_sources: what the latest re-check found and the URLs fetched for it
edge_fields.new_in_version: true if added in this version
edge_fields.register_row_ids: all register rows that carry this object
edge_fields.saiddone: SAID (someone said it) | DONE (documented act) | BOTH, from the primary register row; null if the row predates the field
edge_fields.source_tier/source_tiers: v17: best source tier on the edge (primary | press | reference | social | other) and URL count per tier; see source_index
edge_fields.n_source_domains/single_source: v17: distinct source domains; single_source = true when <= 1 (re-check first)

source_index.note: v17. Every source URL on every sourced edge, bucketed by web domain into a tier: primary = government / court / regulator filing or the actor's own official page or post; press = established news outlet; reference = wiki / database / document mirror; social = X, LinkedIn, YouTube etc.; other = blogs, newsletters, unknown. Per edge (also in edges[], CSV and GraphML): source_tier = best tier present, source_tiers = URL count per tier, n_source_domains, single_source (<= 1 distinct domain). A tier describes where the paper sits, not whether the claim is true: grade V/I and SAID/DONE still carry the judgment. Domain buckets are a fixed list in build.py (unknown domains fall to 'other').
source_index.weak_note: weak = best tier is social/other (no primary, press or reference URL): re-check these first.

pair_index.note: v18. Pairs of actors joined by 2+ sourced edges (repeat dealings), computed from register edges only, retired excluded. Family members and one person's vehicles are folded into one unit (units below) and edges inside a unit are dropped. Direction is from -> to AS FILED (read each claim for who did what). two_way_money = at least one money edge in each direction (category funding or contract, or a $ amount in the type/label). A repeat pair or a two-way flow is time order, not a claim of exchange or quid pro quo.

bridge_index.note: v19. Brokers between power centres, from register edges only (retired excluded). betweenness = normalized Brandes betweenness centrality on the undirected sourced graph (share of shortest paths between all other actor pairs that pass through this actor; 0-1). clusters_reached = clusters of its neighbours other than its own. cluster_pairs = every pair of power centres with the sourced edges that cross between them and the actors on most of those edges. Structural position only: a high score means many documented ties route through this actor, not that it directs anything.

said_done_ledger.note: v20. Per actor: its sourced ties (register edges, retired excluded) split by what the primary register row's V covers: SAID (a statement was made), DONE (a documented act: filing, payment, appointment, vote), BOTH, or unknown (row predates the field, mostly Oct 8-9 rows). said_share = SAID / graded. said_and_done_pairs = actor pairs (family/vehicle units as in pair_index) with at least one SAID edge and one DONE/BOTH edge, so a reader can set the words next to the acts. said_only_actors = actors with 2+ graded ties, all SAID. Keeps SAID separate from DONE; a SAID tie is not refuted by being SAID. unknown_inferred_from_claim_text = a v20 HEURISTIC for unknown rows only (claim opens with an act word like APPOINTMENT/FUNDING/CONTRACT -> DONE; contains the token SAID -> SAID; both -> BOTH). It is not a register grade and is never added to said/done/both.

freshness_index.note: v21. Per sourced tie (register edges, retired excluded): last_checked = the latest dated verification (the day it was added, a status change, or a dated re-check note), days_since_check counted to as_of. Buckets: fresh <=14 days, aging 15-45, stale >45. A stale tie is not a wrong tie; it means nobody has re-read the source since then, so a role or deal may have moved. recheck_queue = active/pending/changed ties unchecked for 30+ days with an endpoint who holds a current office (office_index) or is a top-25 broker (bridge_index), oldest first: the list the nightly run re-checks next.

open_questions.note: v23.
